summary: Create parent groups with :children in INI or children: in YAML. Child members are parent members, groups can have many parents but no cycles, hosts are processed once with data merged, and hosts/groups are global so redefinitions add to or overwrite them.
questions: How do I create a group of groups in inventory?
What happens if I define the same host in two places?
Is a host in two groups run twice?

answer_card.title: Parent and child groups
answer_card.answer_md:
INI uses `[prod:children]`; YAML uses `children:`:
```yaml
prod:
  children:
    east:
test:
  children:
    west:
```
- Hosts in a child group are automatically in the parent.
- Multiple parents/children are fine, but no circular relationships.
- A host in several groups runs **once**; its data is merged.
- Hosts and groups are global: redefining one adds info or overwrites conflicting values with the latest definition.
